references.text: The prophecy of giving those who mourn in Zion oil of gladness instead of sorrow, and a song of praise instead of a spirit of despair, can be seen as a foreshadowing of the act of anointing Jesus' body for burial.

The psalm that speaks of preparing a table and anointing the head with oil in the presence of enemies can be interpreted as a foreshadowing of the anointing of Jesus' body, even though the context is different.
The use of spices and ointments for the dead in Israelite burial practice, as part of the law, can be seen as background to the act of anointing Jesus' body for burial.
